narrative.overview: Lines is set as an evening literary supplement printed for one person's collection: masthead, dateline, an index of sources and tags, a lead item and columns of short items. The frame carries the character; the reading column stays calm. Dark because of the use scene, never pure white or pure black.
keyCharacteristics: Heavy serif masthead with one red stop
Lead quote over two thirds, side column of three, columns below
Hierarchy from weight, size and rules, never cards or shadows
Every filter visible in the index

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Press red marks only the masthead stop, the current filter and search hits.

rules.name: Rules, not boxes
rules.body: Groups separate by double rules and hairlines; no cards, fills or shadows.

dos: Do make emphasis with weight or size
Do keep every quote's source and tags clickable
donts: Don't use a pure white or pure black ground
Don't put kickers above quotes or number items
Don't add cards, shadows, gradients or rounded blocks
